<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def objs(f):
    return sorted((n['color'],n['pixels'],tuple(map(tuple,n['boundary']))) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'])
before = objs(current_frame)
action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','UP'])
print('res:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','gameplay_changed','score','level_completed','game_over','done')})
after = objs(current_frame)
for x in after:
    if x not in before: print('NEW:', x)
for x in before:
    if x not in after: print('GONE:', x)
</parameter>
</function>
